The '''HLC-14 heavy laser cannon''' was a type of heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] developed by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. HLC-14 cannons featured high accuracy, long range, and significant damage, but possessed a slow rate of fire and significant power consumption. SoroSuub's [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] manufacturing facilities were captured by the Empire during the [[Great Galactic War]], making HLC-14s particularly rare.
